legacy.title: Built by farmers. Growing for six decades.
legacy.body: Founded as a cooperative sugar mill by Late Shri Shankarrao Kolhe, the group now spans sugar, energy, agri-inputs, pharma, education and IT.

founder.title: A cooperative idea that grew into an institution.
founder.p1: In 1960, Sahakar Maharshi Shankarrao Genuji Kolhe (1929–2022), former Minister of Maharashtra, brought the farmers of Kopargaon together to build their own sugar mill. What began as a cooperative of cane growers became an integrated rural enterprise — in sugar, green energy, agri-inputs, pharmaceuticals and education.
founder.p2: In 1983 he founded the Sanjivani Rural Education Society, so that the children of farmers and workers could become engineers, pharmacists and leaders without leaving rural Maharashtra.

milestone.title: India's first cooperative compressed biogas plant.
milestone.body: Inaugurated by the Union Minister of Cooperation at Kopargaon, our multi-feed CBG and potash granule plant turns molasses, press mud and crop residue into clean fuel and fertiliser — a model the Centre plans to take to more cooperative sugar mills.
